author: National Geographic
description:
Is the lost city of Atlantis real? In this full episode of Lost Treasures of Ancient Civilizations from National Geographic, historian Dan Snow travels to Greece to discover the truth about the legendary lost city, made famous by Plato's ancient works. Dive under the sea and swim through a sunken city's streets; walk through a magnificent lost royal palace, and discover exciting new evidence of a lost coastal city, revealing fact and fiction behind the legend of Atlantis.
